test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G went to a restaurant for dinner. All of them contributed to the bill. Each person paid a different amount. C paid more than only E, and F paid more than A. B paid less than A. D paid the highest amount, and E paid the least amount. If G paid more than two persons in the group, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: F paid less than D but more than C
A was among the lowest four payers
G paid more than E but less than C
B paid less than D and G

solution:
Seven people went to the restaurant, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, and paid different bill amounts.

__
 
• ___ > ___ > ___ > ___ > ___ > ___ > ____ .
 
• D paid the highest amount, and E paid the least amount

 D __ > ___ > ___ > ___ > ___> ___ >__ E __ . 

__
 
• If G paid more than two persons in the group

 D __ > ___ > ___ > ___ >__ ____**G **__> ___ >__ E __ .

__
 
• F paid more than A. B paid less than A. ⇒ **F > A > B**

** ** D __ > __ __**__F __** > __ ____**A** __ > **__ B __** >__ G __> ___ >__ E __ .

__
 
• C paid more than only E

 D __ > __ ____F __ > __ ____A __ > **__ B __** >__ ____G __> **__ C __** >__ E __ .

According, to the arrangement.

Statement 1: F paid less than D but more than C ⇒ **True**

Statement 2: A was among the lowest four payers ⇒ **False **(A is the third highest payer.)

Statement 3: G paid more than E but less than C ⇒ **False **(G paid more than C and E)

Statement 4: B paid less than D and G ⇒ **False **(B paid less than D but more than G)

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
